captions.detailed: A 3D-printable six-sided game die featuring rounded edges and corners. The faces of the die display indented circular dots (pips) representing the numbers 1 through 6 in standard configurations. The overall geometry is a smooth, rounded cube with clean, uniform bevels on all edges.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable six-sided game die in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the overall size of the die (dice_size), the radius of the circular pips (circle_radius), the depth of the pips (digit_depth), the edge rounding radius (rounding), and choose between a solid or hollow design (dice_type).
captions.factory: The code defines a parametric die by assembling six sides. Each side is constructed using a base cube and four cylinders placed at the corners, which are then combined using a 'hull()' operation to create the rounded-edge cube shape. The pips are generated as small cylinders positioned according to standard dice patterns (1-6) and are subtracted from the main rounded cube using a 'difference()' boolean operation. For hollow dice, an inner scaled-down version is subtracted from the outer shell.
